text:
I cannot thank this Tan-diau veterinary hospital enough for the incredible care they gave my dog. He was diagnosed with stage 2 heart disease, and I truly thought I was going to lose him. I was scared and overwhelmed, but from the moment I brought him in, the entire team took such good care of him.

They were thorough, compassionate, and determined to find the right medication—and they did. Thanks to their expertise and dedication, my dog is doing so much better, and I feel like I have more precious time with him.

Every member of the staff was kind, attentive, and genuinely caring. You can really feel how much they love animals and how committed they are to helping both pets and their owners.

I’m beyond grateful and would highly recommend them to anyone who wants the very best care for their pets.❤️🙏🙏🥰
We found them due what we thought was a emergency for one of our Dogs. Great staff and services. Highly recommended.

We didn't have a good experience with this clinic. We had a microchip implanted and a consultation there. The breeder brought our puppy in with itching and spots on his neck. They told us it was probably fungus and prescribed a soothing aloe lotion. When we realized on the third day that it wasn't helping and the itching was only getting worse, we went to the university clinic, where they took a swab and found staphylococcus. They prescribed antibiotics, which we took for a week, and everything finally cleared up. They also consulted about an iron deficiency, which was found in the tests, something they hadn't even told us about at Tan-diau.

Our puppy fell off the sofa and got hurt. They saw her right away and took care of her. She was there for two days and it was less than 4000 Bhat. Very affordable and good care for the puppy.

Update: Puppy is doing great. We continue to use them for shots and other miscellaneous issues with our 3 dogs. They do house calls which is great and removes the stress of getting 3 dogs into the vet.
All vets and staff love in their career, they love animal as I can feel, trusted pet hospital in Hua Hin recommend

It's simply unbelievable! I sent an email to the Tan Diau Pet Hospital a week ago, on December 1st, at 8:00 AM. I asked for help with my dog. I'm elderly and can no longer carry him. He needed veterinary care, a nail trim, and his fur needed to be cut due to diarrhea. My dog ​​is difficult, not a lamb. The organization Rescue PAWS recommended this clinic. What happened? Nothing! No callback, no contact. It's a tragedy and not even worth one star.
The best veterinarian clinic in Hua Hin, I have been a client with TDHP for 8 years. The staff and doctors are professional, trying to help with any requests.

Went there for emergency after hours. The staff promptly muzzled my dog and gave him an X-ray.
Fractured bones in leg was the result and vet explained everything in English and treatment required. Gave him an injection for pain and meds for the week.
3 people tended to him and they were all very caring and professional. Could not have been better.
Under the circumstances it was a good visit and great to know they are only up the road.
They were reasonably priced and will be our regular vet when staying at our house in Hua Hin.

My cat looks very weak and did not want to move anymore. I decided to bring her to meet the vet here. They can speak English and found out my cat was very dehydration. The vet did blood test and the results showing she had high kidney values. My cat was admitted to this hospital for further treatment. After a week, the kidney values have improved significantly and are back to a much better condition, appreciated their services.

I was very much disappointed with this veterinary clinic and would not return. The service was poor, and the costs were very high. They seemed more focused on prescribing numerous medications rather than identifying the root cause of the issue. Explanations were only provided when I specifically asked for them. The doctor was for the most part distracted by questions from the staff, appeared disengaged and lacked enthusiasm for her work. It felt like their main priority was making money rather than delivering quality care. Despite clear indications that nothing was broken, an unnecessary X-ray was taken. Overall, the clinic seemed more interested in prescribing treatments than in diagnosing and addressing the underlying problem.
I definitively would not recommend this clinic to any pet owner

Emergency service!
I recommend this hospital to anyone who is in urgent need or looking a vet in general.

5/5* service even after closing hours, the staff and doctor is friendly, and patiently listening and amazing.

** I had to take my dog to the vet after he had been constipated from eating a bone and had blood in his stool.

I found Tan-diau pet Hospital on google and I messaged the clinic after closing hours (23:00/11:00pm) to my surprise they were fast to respond to my urgent request.

- I explained the issue and the doctor told me he would prepare the staff and clinic ASAP!
Within half an hour I was allowed to come and was greeted by the staff and doctor, they took my dog straight to xray and began treating him.

Fortunately, there was no issues besides constipation and the doctor pointed at the xray and told us, “Don’t worry, it’s coming”
The next day my dog could relieve itself with no issues.

Your pet will be in good hands while getting a treatment here.

Professional and inexpensive service, accurate diagnosis and treatment. I brought my dog with a swollen snout, the vet accurately diagnosed that it was dental problems. 2 teeth extractions and abscess draining and tartar removal in one day. The best part: the vets are very gentle & caring with the pets!

The best vet in Hua Hin. Very reasonably priced, fast and efficient service, excellent knowledgeable, helpful and caring staff! I had to arrange a titre test for my cat before he went back to the uk and they arranged it all for me and took care of him very well. The price is very reasonable and they will always make time to take care of your pet! I would highly recommend! Would bring my pets back here 100%!

I visited Tan-diau pet hospital at opening time, was seen immediately and at 11am two members of staff picked up my sick dog from my house. They returned our dog early afternoon after treatment for a bad mouth infection. Throughout the staff were pleasant and caring and the bill was very reasonable.
All in all an excellent and professional service.
Dr David Smith

We needed to use a vet in Hua Hin as an emergency, whilst on holiday. I was really impressed with how efficiently and compassionately the staff here dealt with our dog (and us!). If I lived here, I would absolutely register with these guys.

Best veterinary practise we have been to not only in Hua Hin but also the whole central area. Very quick service, caring, friendly,  knowledgeable staff. Excellent service.  Gave us very good advice. Took time to explain everything.  Really recommend this clinic for your pet(s).

Great service and love for the animals there, they really tried to keep my cat alive when he was dying. Prices are very reasonable. They sometimes text you if your pet is staying there and send you updates.

Highly skilled Dr.
Fully equipped..A real hospital..
All major tests and operations
Sends updated videos of your pets situation..
They love the animals
Really fair prices..
Happy I found them..
Excellent experience friendly staff, my dog was so happy to visit

We have been twice with emergency situations and have been very pleased with the response and helpfulness of all the staff, they really care about the animals and owners. I have no hesitation recommending the Hospital to pet owners.
A very good well equipt pet hospital. Very professional and will definately use their services going forward.
Amazing doctors and staff!  They really care about you and your pets. They are extremely knowledgeable and explain everything thoroughly. I am grateful that they are here!😻 …
Care vets and assistants everybody welcome feel comfort to be there recommended
Brownie has been cared for several times at Tan- diau, and each time the care and service has been excellent.
Bad communication. Unnecessary treatment. Wrong treatment . Start a treatment without searching the source . Over priced.

Very helpful and caring staff.
Excellent vet.
Best vet's in Hua Hin in my opinion.
1st visit was good. Helpful and friendly. Communication was in English
Nice, clean and very professional vet hospital.
Good friendly staff and cheap prices.  Speak good English too.
Great service, with much love for animals.
GOOD service with knowledgeable doctors.
The best pets clinic in Hua Hin.
Very professional and caring staff.
Nice people who love animals.
Very good
Absolutely professional clinic! They saved my little girls life.

The care, respect and communication are five stars. The dignity and compassion the staff have for their patients far exceeds five stars. Thankful and grateful for this veterinary hospital. They provided me with answers that allowed for …

I was very impressed. I brought my dog ​​here for a health checkup and teeth cleaning. The vet explained everything in detail and was very attentive. The hospital is clean, spacious, and the cost is reasonable.

Highly recommended.

We were very pleased with our cat's ultrasound: the doctor was very attentive, showed and explained everything, printed out the results, and sent photos to Laine.

After the ultrasound, she asked about the medications we were giving her and provided feedback.

We were very pleased with our visit to this veterinary clinic.
A good veterinary clinic, they immediately accepted my dog ​​and helped, gave him an IV, etc. The prices are normal, the doctors are good.
Highly recommended, very friendly and they were very kind to my dogs (Rottweilers).
Very very warm welcome, dogs are very welcome too, the staff is lovely
Very nice people. The young female doctor speaks good English.
It's a very clean hospital and they paid attention to every detail for my child. Excellent! I like and thank the doctor and all the assistants.
The staff were eager to help, carrying them to the car. I felt that they truly loved animals.
Fantastic hospital, very caring and friendly. Competent team who know all about animals. Our tortoise is completely healthy again! 🤗 …
Excellent service at every level.
Excellent service and very friendly staff. Competent and truly animal-loving employees. Home visits are always possible and very affordable...😂😉👍😊😀 💕🐕😊 …
Excellent service.
